decision.reason: Promise Robotics' 13 October multi-year D.R. Horton deal explicitly includes factory robotic production and onsite installation for 1,250+ homes, supporting a plausible factory-to-site revision/delivery/acceptance coordination ledger, subject to later competition validation.
decision.article_title: Promise Robotics strikes deal to supply largest US homebuilder DR Horton - BetaKit

opportunities.core_job: Reconcile prefabricated housing design revision, factory deliverables, on-site constraints and installation acceptance for each house lot
opportunities.target_customer: Homebuilders using robotic offsite prefabrication, factory/site integration project managers
opportunities.product_mechanism: Design revision/house-lot registry → factory kit checklist → shipment/site-readiness exceptions → crew acceptance → punch and signoff
opportunities.why_now: Promise Robotics and D.R. Horton announced a multi-year Factory-as-a-Service agreement for 1,250+ homes in Phoenix
opportunities.before_state: Offsite fabrication status, build-plan versions, logistics deliveries and site-installation issue tracking are separate
opportunities.after_state: Per-home digital handoff linking approved plan revision, robot-built kit, delivery constraints, installer signoff and punch list

source_observations.observation: Company confirms D.R. Horton multi-year agreement supporting 1,250+ homes with robotic factory operations and onsite installation.
